def sdbm(key):
    """
    This function is a good bit scrambling function.

    This algorithm was created for sdbm (a public-domain
     reimplementation of ndbm) database library.
    """
    hash = 0

    for letter in str(key):
        hash = ord(letter) + (hash << 6) + (hash << 16) - hash
    
    return hash
